newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Euro airlines post 7.6 pct traffic rise in August.
newsitem.headline: Euro airlines post 7.6 pct traffic rise in August.

text.p: West European airlines posted 7.6 percent growth in passenger traffic in August, compared to the year-ago period, the Association of European Airlines said on Monday.
"This was one of the better monthly results in a year which has seen the market unable to settle down into a consistent growth trend," the association said in a statement.
Intra-European services grew 8.1 percent, the best monthly result this summer, while Far Eastern services increased 9.1 percent. The North Atlantic had the lowest growth of six percent.
Airfreight grew seven percent with the Far East/ Australia increasing by 9.5 percent and consolidating its lead over the North Atlantic, which grew by only 3.5 percent.
But the association's secretary general, Karl-Heinz Neumeister, warned of increasing cost and competitive pressures.

"Politicians continually demand cheaper fares without recognising that this is only possible with growth, and a precondition of growth is the infrastructure to accommodate it, which they are failing to deliver," he said in the statement.
The association represents all the major flag carriers in western Europe.
